title: Anessa Perfect UV Sunscreen Milk SPF50+ PA++++
description_en: The gold standard of Japanese sun protection — Shiseido's Anessa features a unique AutoBoost technology that forms a stronger UV shield when exposed to sweat, water, and heat. Lightweight, non-greasy finish.
description_ja: シセイドウのANESSAが誇る「AutoBoostテクノロジー」。汗・水・熱に触れると防御力が増す独自設計。軽いテクスチャーでべたつかない日焼け止めの最高峰。
